algorithm.title: Initial Management Algorithm for Pulmonary Artery Hypertension

cell.label: Treatment-naive patient with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH).
Referral to a PAH expert center.
Treat with a high-dose calcium channel blocker and reassess 3 to 6 months later.
Initial oral therapy with a PDE5 inhibitor or an ERA.
Initial ERA plus PDE5 inhibitor therapy.
Initial ERA plus PDE5 inhibitor and an IV or subcutaneous prostacyclin analogue.

footnotes.footnote: *Positive vasoreactivity: a drop in mean pulmonary artery pressure of more than 10 mm Hg, to less than 40 mm Hg, with increased or unchanged cardiac output.
ERA, endothelin receptor antagonist; PDE5, phosphodiesterase type 5.
